import asyncio
from fastmcp.server import FastMCP
from fastmcp.client import Client
from fastmcp.transport.local import LocalTransport


async def main():
    # Create server
    server = FastMCP("example-server")
    
    # Register resource handler
    @server.resource("data://config")
    def get_config():
        return "configuration data"
    
    # Create in-memory transport connecting client to server
    transport = LocalTransport(server)
    
    # Create client and connect to server
    client = Client(transport)
    
    # Fetch resource contents
    resource = await client.read_resource("data://config")
    print(resource)


asyncio.run(main())
